description: Source code implementing PCIe endpoint data transfer functions with support for memcpy and DMA, including handling of different system architectures and outbound memory types.

methods.name: pcie_ep_mapped_copy
methods.description: Performs memory copy between mapped PCIe address and local address, with architecture-specific address validation.

methods.name: pcie_ep_xfer_data_memcpy
methods.description: Transfers data via PCIe outbound memory using memcpy, with address mapping, unmapping, and flush operations.

methods.name: pcie_ep_xfer_data_dma
methods.description: Transfers data via PCIe outbound memory using DMA, including explicit PCIe read flush for high outbound memory on 32-bit systems.
